steps.instruction: On the Bench Board project board, create a new task with title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Task' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task for run {{runid}}'). Leave the due date unset for now. After saving, report the task's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (Kanboard shows it as #<number> on the task card and task page) and confirm the task appears on the board.

On the Bench Board board, move the task '{{runid}} Bench Task' (task #4) from the {{02-create.column}} column into the '{{01-open.column_3}}' column (drag the card, or use the card's move option). Do not touch any tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'. Verify afterwards that the card now sits in the '{{01-open.column_3}}' column and report which column it is in.

Open task #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Task') in the Bench Board project. Add a comment to the task whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Then set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (edit the task details; Kanboard's date field may accept typing the date in format 2026-12-31 or via a date picker). Verify both changes are saved: report the comment text as shown on the task page and the due date as displayed.

Final verification on the Bench Board project: open the board and confirm (a) the left-to-right column names, (b) that task #4 '{{runid}} Bench Task' sits in the '{{01-open.column_3}}' column. Then open task #4's page and confirm (c) the description text includes '{{runid}}', (d) there is a comment containing '{{runid}}' (report its text), (e) the due date shown (report exactly as displayed), and (f) the task ID shown as #<number>. Report all six values.
